Nina P.: Quick kudos thread 60; Rahul sprinted to the pantry when the espresso machine coughed up a screaming error during demo prep and got it back online in 3 mins. Saved the morning :coffee::clap:
Rahul S.: lol surprised it was still under warranty in my brain. happy to help, and I will accept all future brownie bribes :brownie:
Becca W.: also huge respect for the basil revival mission. the plant was asking for help. Rahul to the rescue with a mister and pep talk :seedling::raised_hands:
Leo M.: proposing an official title: "Espresso Ambulance and Plant Whisperer". Plaque? sticker? temporary tattoo? :laughing:
Nina P.: vote: :star: sticker, :medal_sports: plaque. React to vote. Poll open 24h.
OpsBot: Poll opened by Nina P. 60; poll will auto-close in 24h.
Rahul S.: :star: (sticker > tattoo)
Becca W.: :star: (I can make a tiny enamel pin if we hit 10 votes)
Leo M.: :medal_sports: (plaque would look legit on the espresso cart)
Nina P.: Adding these kudos to wins board and to next retro shoutouts. Thanks team, simple saves like this make demo days calm :sparkles:
Rahul S.: honored. I will run a 10-min espresso basics micro-session next Tuesday 60; pastries provided if people promise to not touch the knobs blindly.
